# Owner window and dialog mode are separate choices

For email X-SHOWDETAILS, choosing the main calendar window fixes document lookup, while choosing view mode also clears args.inTab and bypasses editor tabs for editable published events. A provisional Bug 2073142 patch based on 2135bbdeb7dd3feafb298c0220b412a66cc41826 reportedly calls modifyEventWithDialog when calendar.item.editInTab is true and retains viewing otherwise. Invitations and read-only events retain their summary branch. This is a local, uncommitted proposal, not an accepted routing convention. The note reports passing native headless tests covering message pane, message tab, standalone window, both read-dialog preferences, and protected items. Coverage used artifact binaries; no full native compilation, Try run, recurrence prompt, event save, live accessibility check, or release-156 binary test ran.

Scope: Calendar email Details preferences.
